hypothesis: Pricing each HIRE as a short-lived capacity purchase and reserving its usable turns for recurring survival, imminent harvest, return, and sale obligations will outperform a_v186's open-job/floor heuristic by buying fewer idle hands in slack states and enough hands before deadline overload.

exact_code_lever.change: Replace workforce_target/open_jobs/JOBS_PER_UNIT and the hour<HIRE_WINDOW loop with hire_capacity_plan(jobs, state).
exact_code_lever.marginal_rule: For kth additional hand, usable_capacity=max(0, 24-hour-1-return_reserve). Hire if captured feasible net job value from adding that hand exceeds Fibonacci hire_cost(k) by 25%, the new hand has at least three usable actions, and post-hire p90 mandatory utilization remains above 0.70; stop at utilization<=0.70 or MAX_HANDS.
exact_code_lever.reservation: Before optional assignment, reserve deadline-indexed actions for threatened WATER/FEED, current-day mandatory service, expiring/capped harvest, carrier return, DROP, and terminal sale. Optional jobs receive only unreserved capacity.

affected_phase: Every day and hour, with largest effects at day start, land/animal expansion, days 15-20 congestion, hours 8-18 backlog, high shed/cargo states, and final liquidation. Hiring after hour 20 normally fails the three-action gate unless it prevents a catastrophic survival/terminal miss.
engine_mechanism: HIRE is a market order with Fibonacci daily marginal cost and appends a hand at the shed. Unit field actions are selected before the market order creates that hand, so the hire cannot act on its purchase turn. Hands and inventories reset at end of day after deposit. Each subsequent turn provides one action per hand, but route distance, input pickup, cargo return, and exact action preconditions consume that capacity. Market HIRE orders share the ten-order cap with buys/sells.
regime_trigger_and_forecast_error: Recalculate after each executed hire, because marginal cost and capacity change. Compare forecast usable actions, mandatory jobs captured, travel, idle turns, return success, and realized job value. If a newly hired hand executes fewer than 50% of predicted valid actions twice, raise travel/coordination penalty; if mandatory lateness occurs despite predicted slack, tighten utilization target by 0.10 [uncertain].
decision_score_audit: For each potential hire log hires_today, Fibonacci cost, remaining turns, return reserve, predicted valid service/travel actions, reserved job set, marginal terminal value captured, displaced market order, utilization before/after, score-cost gap, hire/reject reason, and realized contribution. Every hand receives a stable reservation ledger and fallback job.
admissible_workload_and_minimum_slack: Forecast deadline demand for the rest of day plus next-day committed survival. Existing workers' usable capacity excludes current turn, travel lower bounds, and end-of-day return. Hire until p90 mandatory utilization <=0.70 and all survival/expiry jobs have >=4-turn slack, provided marginal value clears cost. A hire itself is not permission to admit new projects unless the recurring multi-day workload also remains feasible [uncertain].
constraint_utilization_profile: By day and hand: valid-action utilization, movement share, idle/PASS, reserved/optional action use, cargo peak, shed trips, market-order cost, and money. Aggregate warnings: labor >80%, movement >45%, idle >25%, shed >90, HIRE+BUY orders >8/10, or hire bill consuming >10% of current cash without captured high-value jobs.
job_queue_health: Reservation queues show count/value, release, deadline, slack, age, lateness, starvation, and owner. Reassign only if the owner cannot arrive before latest start or a higher-criticality job emerges. Optional development is abandoned before stealing reserved survival/harvest capacity. Report reservation breaks and jobs completed by non-owner.
spatial_logistics_metrics: Marginal hire value includes spawn-to-job distance, batching, route switches, and return-to-shed. Assign new hands to compact zones or commodity routes; report distance/completed job, empty travel, pickup batch, harvest batch, shed trips, and cross-zone switches per hand. Remote one-off work seldom justifies a hire.
expected_terminal_value: Incremental value is terminal cash captured by the extra hand minus hire cost, market-order displacement, coordination/movement, and overflow/price impact. Candidate effect is not measured [uncertain].
marginal_value_per_worker_turn: For each potential hire compute the best feasible increase in terminal value divided by its incremental valid worker actions, and compare it with current capacity shadow price. Report realized value/action and idle-adjusted value/action. Values are [uncertain].
shadow_price_vector: lambda_labor is the best rejected deadline-feasible job per action; hire when lambda_labor times usable marginal actions exceeds hire cost plus lambda_order and route costs. Include cash, movement, shed, cargo, tile, and market-order prices. Phase-specific numerical estimates are [uncertain].
gross_to_net_value_decomposition: For each hand/day: gross job value, avoided asset loss, hire cost, movement/coordination, input financing, displaced orders, overflow, price impact, idle actions, and terminally unbanked cargo. Reconcile net hand contribution to candidate-control terminal cash where possible.
market_and_opponent_dependence: Market/town/opponent state changes job value and displaced-order cost. High opponent glut lowers optional harvest/hire value; threatened assets still require service. High absorption can justify harvest capacity. A saturated order list raises lambda_order and can make HIRE unattractive even if field labor is scarce.
action_validity_and_noop_breakdown: A reservation must check exact tile and input state at dispatch. Count attempts/valid/executed/no-op by hand and reason: stale target, contention, missing input, already serviced, locked/wrong tile, full shed, insufficient cash, off-board move, and market truncation. Current candidate results are [uncertain].
micro_scenario_coverage: Tests: first through twelfth Fibonacci hire cost; hire at hours 0/9/22; no action on hire turn; end-of-day disappearance/deposit; one threatened remote plant; animal feed with wheat pickup; ten-order contention; two hands claiming one job/item; full shed return; idle hand; exact latest-start harvest; terminal carrier; and a new project that is feasible today but not tomorrow.
terminal_feasibility: Late hires must have a complete assigned chain ending in banked sales. Reserve route home and DROP before day end; on final day reserve explicit SELL timing. Value cargo at zero if the added hand cannot deposit and sell by step 719. Do not hire solely for an action whose output is stranded.
paired_test_design: Compare a_v186 with only workforce/hire/reservation changed. Use 1,536 paired seat outcomes, six opponent strata, balanced seats, audited RNG. Primary win uplift; secondary daily hire bill/count, idle rate, mandatory lateness, captured expiring value, valid actions, and terminal cargo.
paired_discordance_and_effect_interval: Report candidate-only/control-only wins, paired uplift and 95% cluster interval. Approximate MDE 3.2-5.0 points for discordance .20-.50. Actual results are [uncertain].
random_stream_alignment: Hiring and completed work change occupancy, so equal official seeds can shift conditional weed draws. Use event-keyed exogenous RNG or event audit plus cluster inference. Worker assignment and tie-breaking must be deterministic.
optional_stopping_and_multiple_testing_b: Tune at most four bundles: utilization target {0.65,0.70}, value margin {1.10,1.25}, with fixed three-action minimum. Freeze one. Holm-correct shared validation claims and use fixed confirmation; no peeking-based stop.
tuning_validation_separation: Estimate travel/coordination corrections on training opponents/seeds; freeze hire thresholds, reservation classes, and fallback before validation. Final confirmation uses disjoint opponent hashes and fresh seeds. Record every attempted threshold bundle.
distributional_guardrails: Require zero increase in survival misses, idle hand rate <=20%, median hire bill not higher without positive captured value, invalid/no-op rate not up >0.5 points, 10th-percentile cash not down >2,000, and no seat/stratum win loss >3 points. Results are [uncertain].
robustness_regret: Report regret versus best threshold bundle by labor-load stratum and versus a_v186. Separate under-hiring loss, over-hiring cost, and late-hire stranded-output regret. No results [uncertain].
rare_event_stress_results: Stress sudden weed/service burst, wheat shortage, premium glut, hour-18 backlog, remote SE jobs, full shed, order saturation, and simultaneous final harvests. Verify capacity reservation protects survival/return and load sheds optional work. Results are [uncertain].
interaction_and_ablation_matrix: Ablate marginal cost, current-turn exclusion, return reserve, survival reserve, expiry reserve, order shadow cost, and zone assignment. Test with workload admission, rolling horizon, endogenous regimes, and shadow-price scoring. Effects are [uncertain].
promotion_margin_and_reversion_trigger: Promote with >=+5-point paired win uplift, lower bound >0, no survival regression, idle and cost guardrails passed, and non-inferiority by stratum. Revert if a hire causes negative realized net value on >25% of hand-days, idle >30%, reserved survival misses, market truncation of essential sells, or live win rate drops >5 points/100 games.
confidence_and_status: High confidence that HIRE should be priced as capacity and current a_v186 open-job floors are coarse; medium confidence in 0.70 utilization, 1.25 margin, and reservation bands. Implementation/benchmark pending; experiment only [uncertain].
computational_budget: Use incremental deadline buckets and a bounded Hungarian/greedy assignment over at most HUNGARIAN_JOBS=48. Target <15 ms and <5 MB. Recompute after hire or material job changes. On timeout, keep existing reservations, stop further hires, and dispatch a_v186's highest valid mandatory job.

artifact_metadata.baseline_levers: HIRE_WINDOW=9; JOBS_PER_UNIT=4.0; workforce_target uses open_jobs/per_hand plus a fixed 6-10 hand floor; MAX_HANDS and HUNGARIAN_JOBS=48.
